messages:
incidentbot: [AUTOPAGER] severity=critical service=gpu-host-monitor host=gpu-host-22 rack=rack-7 alert=kubelet_unready reason=kernel_panic links=<https://pagerduty.example/INC123456|PD:INC123456>

pagerduty: Page triggered: INC123456 — target: eng-sre oncall (rotation: alex). Escalation: in 3m to sam if unacked.

alex: oncall (alex) — acked. I'm taking this. quick summary?

maria: saw the alert. console shows kernel panic, kubelet not ready. multiple pods on gpu-host-22 were OOM/evicted.

tyler: ping — looks like node dropped out during busy model batch jobs. metric snapshot: `node.gpu-host-22.cpu.util=95%`, `node.gpu-host-22.pods=42`, `kubelet.uptime=0s`.

alex: thanks. any customer-facing impact? which tenant workloads hit?

maria: checking `kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-host-22` — a few prod-ml pods for tenant:theta and internal-realtime. 3 LROs failed but autoscaler moved some to host pool.

tyler: here's the serial console tail (last 40 lines):
```
[  102.345678] ------------[ cut here ]------------
[  102.345680] kernel panic - not syncing: Attempted to kill init!
[  102.345682] CPU: 3 PID: 1 Comm: systemd Not tainted 5.15.0-rc1 #1
[  102.345684] Call Trace:
[  102.345686]  dump_stack+0x6c/0x98
[  102.345688]  panic+0xd8/0x254
[  102.345690]  do_exit+0x1b0/0x3c0
```

alex: that confirms kernel panic. let's cordon and drain to avoid rescheduling to same host. Maria can you cordon? I'll open incident in PD as P1.

maria: on it.

maria: `kubectl cordon gpu-host-22` — done.

maria: running drain: `kubectl drain gpu-host-22 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=60`

maria: drain completed for non-daemonset pods. 14 pods evicted/rescheduled. tenant:theta reported 2 pod restarts, internal-realtime had a degraded window ~1m.

alex: good. I'm tagging PD incident INC123456 with customers impacted: tenant:theta (low-medium), internal-realtime (medium). Notifying support for customer comms.

tyler: infra note: nvme S.M.A.R.T shows intermittent errors on host. `smartctl -a /dev/nvme0` showing increasing corrected error count. possible HW fault.

maria: ordering RMA and scheduling swap for host. moving workloads to dedicated pool while we replace. I'll pin capacity.

alex: can you flip routing on Redwood Console to avoid scheduling on rack-7 temporarily? `console route add --exclude rack-7` or set pool to maintenance.
maria: doing maintenance mode for rack-7 now.

sam: (escalation) — I'm up in 12m for handoff, will join and take postmortem. ping me oncall if you want earlier.

alex: thanks sam. I'll stay for handoff. Maria/Tyler, please keep logs and `kubectl describe` outputs attached to the PD incident.

tyler: saved `/var/log/serial/gpu-host-22-boot.log` and uploaded to PD. also collected `dmesg` and kubelet logs.

maria: RMA request opened with provider; ETA replacement hardware 8 hours. marking incident PROVISIONAL -> action: evacuate and RMA.

alex: next steps: (1) confirm all evicted pods healthy in new hosts, (2) keep rack-7 maintenance until hw swapped, (3) update support with affected tenants and mitigation timeline, (4) full postmortem with timeline + root cause.

incidentbot: Escalation timer: 00:02:00 until next escalation to sam if no ack change.

alex: closing loop here — ack resolved in thread: node is cordoned/drained, customer impact limited, replacement scheduled. keeping PD incident open until host replaced. I'll hand off to sam at :00. :white_check_mark:
